title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Answers to common questions about choosing, ordering and placing a memorial. If you don't see your question here, we're happy to help.

questions.question: What's the difference between flat, bevel and slant markers?
questions.answer: A flat marker sits level with the ground. A bevel marker is slightly raised with a gently sloped face, and a slant marker has a steeper angled face that's easier to read while standing. Some cemeteries only allow certain types, so we'll check before you decide.

questions.question: What granite colors are available?
questions.answer: Most designs come in several granite colors, such as gray, black, rose and blue pearl. The colors offered for each design are listed in its gallery details, and we can show you samples.

questions.question: Can you add a photo, emblem or custom artwork?
questions.answer: Yes. Many families add an emblem, a meaningful symbol or other artwork to the design. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll show you what's possible on the design proof.

questions.question: Do you create fully custom designs?
questions.answer: Every design in our gallery can be adapted in size, color and lettering. If you're looking for something different, let us know and we'll talk through the options.

questions.question: How long does it take to get a headstone?
questions.answer: Timing depends on the design, the granite and the cemetery's schedule. We'll give you an estimated timeline when you place your order and keep you updated along the way.

questions.question: Will I see a proof before it's made?
questions.answer: Yes. You'll review and approve a design proof showing the layout, lettering and any artwork before anything is made.

questions.question: Can a date be added later, such as for a companion memorial?
questions.answer: Yes. Names and dates can be added to an existing memorial later. Let us know when the time comes and we'll take care of it.

questions.question: Does my cemetery have rules about memorial size or type?
questions.answer: Many cemeteries have rules about the size, type and placement of memorials. Tell us which cemetery you're working with and we'll help you find a design that meets its requirements.

questions.question: Do you handle installation?
questions.answer: Yes. We coordinate with the cemetery and set the memorial, so you don't have to manage the details yourself.

questions.question: How much does a memorial cost?
questions.answer: The price depends on the design, size, granite color and lettering. Request information or give us a call and we'll prepare a quote with no cost or obligation.

questions.question: Do you offer payment plans?
questions.answer: Ask us about payment options when you request a quote, and we'll explain what's available.
